name: BTC one-, ten-, and thirty-second momentum
description: Causal simple basis-point returns of the ready BTC spot reference over one, ten, and thirty one-second observations. direction_10s is down, flat, or up from the full-precision ten-second return. Any missing or non-ready one-second reference observation breaks continuity and restarts the 30-second warm-up. Decimal outputs are rounded to eight places using round-half-to-even.
